name.description: Name is the object identifier used by references.

Metadata.description: Metadata identifies an OpenSLO v1alpha object.

startTime.description: StartTime anchors the first calendar window.

timeZone.description: TimeZone controls the interpretation of StartTime and later boundaries.

thresholdMetric.description:
ThresholdMetric retrieves raw metric values.
Each objective compares them with its [Operator] and Value.

SLOIndicator.description: SLOIndicator defines the threshold-metric form of a v1alpha service level indicator.

source.description: Source identifies the metric data source.

queryType.description: QueryType identifies the query language or query form.

query.description: Query is the provider-specific expression that retrieves the metric.

SLOMetricSourceSpec.description: SLOMetricSourceSpec describes a provider-specific metric query.

displayName.description: DisplayName is a human-readable objective name.

value.description: Value is the metric threshold used by [Operator].

target.description: BudgetTarget is the desired fraction of good events or time slices.

timeSliceTarget.description:
TimeSliceTarget is the minimum success ratio that makes a time slice good.
It is used by the Timeslices budgeting method.

op.description: Operator compares values returned by the threshold metric with Value.

SLOObjective.description: SLOObjective defines a reliability target and, for the ratio form, its metric queries.

good.description: Good retrieves the numerator: events considered successful.

total.description: Total retrieves the denominator: all considered events.

incremental.description:
Incremental reports whether the queried metrics are monotonically increasing counters
rather than values that can rise or fall.

SLORatioMetrics.description: SLORatioMetrics defines an indicator as the ratio of good events to total events.

timeWindows.description: TimeWindows defines the period over which the SLO is evaluated.

budgetingMethod.description: BudgetingMethod applies the selected error-budget calculation to every objective.

indicator.description: Indicator defines the threshold-metric form of the SLO.

service.description: Service is the metadata name of the [Service] whose reliability the SLO measures.

objectives.description:
Objectives contains reliability targets.
For the ratio form, each objective's [SLOObjective.RatioMetrics] defines the SLI metric queries.

SLOSpec.description: SLOSpec defines the service, indicator, objectives, time window, and error-budget calculation for an SLO.

unit.description: Unit combines with Count to set the window length.

count.description: Count sets how many Units form the window.

isRolling.description: IsRolling selects a continuously advancing window when true and a calendar-aligned window when false.

calendar.description: Calendar defines the alignment of a calendar window.

SLOTimeWindow.description: SLOTimeWindow defines the period over which an SLO is evaluated.

description: SLO is the legacy v1alpha SLO representation supported by this SDK.
